code.description:
A code from [`ApiCode`] or [`JoinFailure`]. Kept as a string so a code this
version does not know still parses.

message.description: Human-readable text for logs. Not shown to people as is.

received_bytes.description: For `offset_mismatch`: the bytes the host has, where the upload resumes.

retry_after_ms.description: How long to wait before retrying, when known.

retryable.description: Whether the same request may succeed later.

description:
The error body of every failed host API or service request:
`{"error": {"code", "message", "retryable", "retry_after_ms"?}}`.
title: ErrorBody
